_comment: eSIM profile configuration with Java Card applet for authentication
_important: For applet-based authentication, set 'use_applet_auth: true'. This will:
_important_4: 4. The applet must be included in 'global_platform.applets.loads' with 'use_for_esim: true'
_comment_ki_opc: Ki and OPc are still required - they will be loaded into the applet via ProcessData APDUs
_comment_use_applet_auth: CRITICAL: Set to true to delegate authentication to applet (algorithmID=3)

global_platform._comment_applets_1: When 'use_applet_auth: true', the applet will handle AUTHENTICATE commands
global_platform._comment_applets_2: The applet must support Milenage/TUAK authentication internally

loads._comment_cap: Path to CAP file (will be converted to IJC format automatically)
loads._comment_aids: AIDs must match the applet's package, class, and instance
loads._comment_use_for_esim: CRITICAL: Must be true for applet to be included in eSIM profile
loads._comment_personalization: Keys will be loaded into applet via ProcessData APDUs during profile installation

milenage_usim._comment_keys: These keys MUST match the Ki/OPc in root config (used for AKA Parameter)
